'''Pol Blex''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] operating on [[Voss]]. He was questioned by the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc Squad Major]] regarding the location of the [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] that was brought to Voss.
